auth_account_no_secrets.name: auth_account_no_secrets
auth_account_no_secrets.value: "auth_account"."access_token" IS NULL AND "auth_account"."refresh_token" IS NULL AND "auth_account"."id_token" IS NULL AND "auth_account"."password" IS NULL AND "auth_account"."access_token_expires_at" IS NULL AND "auth_account"."refresh_token_expires_at" IS NULL

screen_request_window_valid.name: screen_request_window_valid
screen_request_window_valid.value: "screen_request"."preferred_start_at" IS NULL OR "screen_request"."preferred_end_at" IS NULL OR "screen_request"."preferred_end_at" > "screen_request"."preferred_start_at"

review_decision_changes_need_comment.name: review_decision_changes_need_comment
review_decision_changes_need_comment.value: "review_decision"."decision" <> 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR ("review_decision"."comment" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("review_decision"."comment") <> '')

schedule_entry_window_valid.name: schedule_entry_window_valid
schedule_entry_window_valid.value: "schedule_entry"."actual_start_at" IS NULL OR "schedule_entry"."actual_end_at" IS NULL OR "schedule_entry"."actual_end_at" > "schedule_entry"."actual_start_at"
